title: An Integrated Framework for Explainable, Fair, and Observable Hospital Readmission Prediction: Development and Validation on MIMIC-IV
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and clinical validation of machine learning models (XGBoost, LightGBM) for hospital readmission prediction using tabular EHR data. While it includes fairness evaluations across demographic subgroups as a technical performance metric, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
